title: Filter the larger NIST P256 checkpoint with an R06 regression replay
status_note: Submitted definition, not queued or executed. Full checkpoint publication, merged implementation pin and nonpreemptible execution setup are prerequisites. Protocol applies prospectively to filtering only.
blocked_on: note:Pin the merged runner commit and select a nonpreemptible lab; pass the S3 resume checkpoint gate before execution.
question: What duplicate and singleton counts does the identical native filter produce on the R08 checkpoint, and what next state does its controller request?
decision_value: Completed native filtering decides whether this specific larger dataset requests further collection or produces prerequisites for a separate matrix review. A failed replay or incomplete run prevents an arithmetic interpretation. Raw relation growth alone cannot decide this.

resources.notes: Rounded resource reservations, not predicted factoring time: two tasks capped at 900 seconds each; 2 CPUs. Require 5 GiB free before copying. No paid or preemptible host.

outputs.result_schema: nist-filter-counts/v1 per arm; unified experiment.export/v1 required in result PR

env.name: nist-yafu-filter-pinned
env.recipe: Nonpreemptible Linux x86-64 AVX2/BMI2 host. Install pinned patched YAFU and its matching native libraries/sievers, Rust, Bash, jq, ripgrep, coreutils, xz and util-linux. Restore the unchanged published R06/R08 checkpoint archives and verify their input manifests; build the Rust checker. Complete the repository S3 resume gate. No remote data publication or selected environment is asserted.

funding.rationale: Blocked submission with no priority or paid resources. Propose funding only after inputs, merged code and environment are available.

cairn.notes: No lease, remote task, objective, funds or machine is created. Filter interruptions are incomplete new executions, not resumed measurements.
